author: Elijah Jero
name: SongLink
description: Automatically generates universal SongLink embeds for supported music service URLs. Admins can register channels for auto-processing.
install_msg: SongLink cog loaded. Use [p]songchannel register <channel> to enable automatic SongLink conversion.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores registered channel IDs. Music URLs are sent to the song.link API to generate universal links.
